Good food, but we didn't eat together!
Jul 2026 • Couples
We visited here one night during our stay in Da Nang. The restaurant is nice, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. The one big issue with our visit was we were served our main courses about 15 minutes apart, meaning we both basically ate alone! Surely, any restaurant knows when a couple order meals, they expect them to be served at the same time so they can eat together. No apology, or acknowledgment of the situation, so maybe this is normal for them, but this marred our visit, and we wouldn't return.
